name: Psy-min Appli -Akumu no Netorare Game-
original_name: サイミンアプリ－悪夢の寝取られゲーム－
source: Kushida Touya attends a boarding school called Saimei Academy on a solitary island in the sea. One day, he receives an email saying he has qualified to participate in a hypnosis game which simultaneously installs a hypnosis app on his device. Although he tests the app on his sister and realizes it's real, Touya is hesitant to participate in the game that involves taking other people's apps until you are the last one remaining. However, when the student council president strips during a school assembly and claims to have no memory of why she did it, he suspects someone with the hypnosis app is responsible and decides to join the game to protect a girl he's close to.
translation: 栉田冬也在海中孤岛上的一所寄宿学校“赛明学园”上学。有一天，他收到一封电子邮件，说他有资格参加催眠游戏，同时在他的设备上安装催眠应用程序。尽管Touya在他姐姐身上测试了该应用程序并意识到它是真实的，但他仍然犹豫是否要参加这个涉及获取其他人的应用程序的游戏，直到你成为最后一个剩下的人。然而，当学生会主席在学校集会期间脱衣并声称不记得为什么这样做时，他怀疑有人使用催眠应用程序对此负责，并决定加入游戏以保护他亲近的女孩。
